04.content: Invest in the next generation as we lead kids and youth to know who God is and who they are in Him.
Accelerate efforts to develop technology and collaborate with partners so every person on earth can engage with the Bible.

0.headingText: Your giving is changing the world.

02.headingText: You can support the work Life.Church is doing in your community and around the world.

00.headingText: When you tithe, you’re trusting God with your finances.

01.content: Tithing is a biblical principle. God calls us to give the first 10% of our income back to Him. We’ve seen God provide abundantly in our church, and we know He will provide abundantly for you and your family when you put Him first in your finances. In fact, it’s the one area in the Bible where God tells you to test Him.

04.content:
“Bring the whole tithe into the storehouse, that there may be food in my house. Test me in this,” says the Lord Almighty, “and see if I will not throw open the floodgates of heaven and pour out so much blessing that there will not be room enough to store it.”
Malachi 3:10 NIV

00.headingText: It’s impossible to out-give God, but you’ll never regret trying.

02.headingText: God gives us good things we don’t deserve and could never earn, like grace and forgiveness. He gave the ultimate gift, His son, for our sins. When you hear us talk about irrational generosity, ​​that’s what we mean. God created you with a generous spirit. We want to help you embrace it by giving beyond your tithe with an offering to one of these causes.

01.content: Fuel the effort to reach people who don’t know Christ by helping launch new Life.Church locations.

04.content: Provide relief to people in crisis and help transform lives alongside like-minded mission partners working in our communities and around the world.

07.content: Equip churches, pastors, and individuals with free tools and content that help them know and share Christ right where they are.

0.headingText: What happens when I give to Life.Church?

00.content: You can find the answer to this question, the most recent financial statements for Life.Church, and the answers to more frequently asked questions on our Giving FAQ page.

0.alt: Phone screen showing how to give

00.headingText: The easiest and best way to give.

01.headingText: With the Life.Church app, giving is easier than ever. Make your gift recurring, use Apple Pay, and more—all right in the app!
